title: Getting Started with Flutter
subtitle: A short introduction to building apps with Flutter
content:
# Getting Started

## Introduction
Flutter is an open-source UI software development toolkit created by Google.

## Setup
To get started, install Flutter SDK and set up your editor.

## First App
Create a new project with `flutter create my_app` and run it.

## Conclusion
You're ready to build beautiful cross-platform apps with Flutter.

title: State Management Options
subtitle: Overview of common approaches for state management
content:
# State Management

## setState
The simplest way to manage state in Flutter is using setState in StatefulWidget.

## Provider
Provider is a recommended approach for scalable applications.

## Bloc
Bloc offers a more structured approach for complex apps.

## Conclusion
Choose the right tool based on app complexity.
